rv.q: The production’s greatest asset is the magnetic chemistry of its four-person cast...
It is unusual, it is unpredictable, it is deeply involving, and there’s nothing else quite like it in New York theater right now.

cn.t: Michael Gardner's adaptation of Cocteau's dark novella earns praise as an ambitious, intense extravaganza that harnesses the hypnotic power of the source material in an intimate downtown setting.
